The '''''Minstrel''-class space yacht''', also known as the '''Ubrikkian luxury space yacht''', was a large [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] produced by [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Jabbaship-bp.jpg|thumb|left|220px|[[:Category:Technical drawing images|Schematics]] of Jabba the Hutt's ''Minstrel''-class yacht, the ''Star Jewel'' .]]
An [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]] design,<ref name="EGVV" /> the ''Minstrel''-class space yacht<ref name="IA" /> was powered by a pair of Ubrikkian [[N2 ion engine]]s, and supplemented by three smaller [[Kuat Systems Engineering/Legends|Kuat]] [[T-c40 ion engine]]s, affording the vessel a [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight]] speed roughly equivalent to that of a [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]]. Two rear vanes acting as ailerons, and side-mounted maneuvering jets mounted on six retractable rods helped the yacht reach an atmospheric top speed of eight hundred [[Kilometer per hour/Legends|kilometers per hour]]. The vessel had a relatively slow Class Two [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] rating thanks to a [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr]] [[CL-14 hyperdrive motivator]] slaved to a standard Ubrikkian hyperdrive unit. Some yachts, such as the one customized by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] for personal use, were armed with six [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] that, while within civilian limits, had capabilities that far exceeded reasonable expectations.<ref name="EGVV" />

==History==
[[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] kept a personal luxury space yacht called the [[Star Jewel/Legends|''Star Jewel'']] as a space [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] customized for personal business trips.<ref name="EGVV" /> The vessel operated as a flying fortress,<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Jabba's Space Cruiser}}</ref> and became infamous for its gaudy appearance and the sordid dealings and "social activities" carried out within. The interior contained the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] throne room, situated beneath a [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] dome, a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] labor pool, a vehicle hangar, a landing bay containing six [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] and two landing shuttles, and sleeping quarters for Jabba and his guests.<ref name="EGVV" /> Jabba installed hidden gunports to surprise any [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who might attempt to attack the vessel.<ref name="CCG" /> The ''[[Nal Hutta Jewel]]'' was an interstellar pleasure craft owned by [[Ganis]], and while his mobile base of operations was well-defended, the yacht was remarkably unostentatious.<ref name="IA" />
